Use case: stylized-concept. Create an actual GAME ANIMATION SPRITE ATLAS, NOT a concept board. Reference: use ONLY the LEFTMOST character, Rustblade Squire, from the supplied image. Preserve his exact identity: small lean bare-boned skeleton, dented broad-brim rusty kettle helmet, asymmetrical rusty shoulder plate, ragged dark burgundy tabard, exposed bony forearms and feet, ONE broad chipped iron short sword held in anatomical RIGHT hand. No shield, no extra gear, no other reference characters.
Output square 2048x2048 RGBA with TRUE TRANSPARENT background, exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows of equally sized cells, no text or labels or grid lines. SIXTEEN unique consecutive poses of a natural in-place WALK CYCLE toward screen LOWER RIGHT (southeast), fixed 3/4 view and perspective. Every cell contains the whole skeleton and sword with ample padding; identical scale, hips center, floor baseline. Keep pixel-art rendering: crisp pixel clusters and hard edges, same muted iron/bone/burgundy palette, no glossy 3D style.
Read frames left-to-right, top-to-bottom. The 16 poses are ONE complete alternating two-step gait, not 16 similar stance copies: frame0 right foot forward left foot back;1 load right;2 compress right knee;3 left toe leaves ground;4 left leg passing under pelvis;5 left knee advancing;6 left leg reaches;7 left heel nearly contacts;8 LEFT foot forward RIGHT foot back (opposite of0);9 load left;10 compress left knee;11 right toe leaves ground;12 right leg passing;13 right knee advancing;14 right leg reaches;15 right heel nearly contacts ready to loop to0. Body moves only small anatomical vertical amounts, tabard sways subtly, right arm carries sword LOW at side pointing down/front throughout, left arm counter-swings. No change of facing. No motion blur, no painted ground/shadow, no glow, no backgrounds. Sword, helmet, proportions and anatomy stay consistent in every frame. This must depict different actual leg/arm poses, not duplicated frames or rotated copies.

Use case: stylized-concept. Actual 16-frame WALK SPRITE ATLAS. The reference contains ONLY ONE character in different animation poses: Rustblade Squire. Preserve exact character identity, proportions, pixel density, art style and equipment: small lean bare-boned skeleton, rusty broad-brim kettle helmet, rusty anatomical RIGHT shoulder plate, dark burgundy ragged tabard, bare bone feet, dark leather belt, ONE broad chipped rust-brown short sword held in anatomical RIGHT hand. NO shield. Do not add robes, skull masks, boots or accessories. Side changes must preserve handedness and asymmetric shoulder equipment, not mirror the entire character. Change viewing direction to NORTH: back fully towards camera, skull face NOT visible, walking toward top of screen. FIX this orientation identically in all sixteen cells; do NOT rotate through directions within the sheet. Square 2048x2048 RGBA true transparency. Exact uniform 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal cells. No text, labels, cell borders, backgrounds, shadows or effects. Whole skeleton and sword fully within each cell with ample margin. Equal scale and ground baseline; stable pelvis position. Sharp deliberately clustered pixel art matching the reference, not glossy 3D.
Sixteen consecutive unique in-place WALK poses in row-major order, one entire alternating two-step cycle: frames0-3 right heel contact, weight loading, compression, left toe-off;4-7 left foot passing under body, swinging forward, extending and nearing contact;8-11 LEFT heel contact, weight loading, compression and right toe-off;12-15 right foot passes under body, swings forward, extends and approaches contact ready to loop to0. Frame8 must have the OPPOSITE leg forward from frame0. Knees bend, heels lift, toes push off; no gliding or repeated stance. Left arm counter-swings, right hand carries sword low pointing forward/down. Subtle tabard trailing motion. Preserve body identity and equipment through every pose. No motion blur or photographic antialiasing.

Use case: stylized-concept. Actual 24-frame SINGLE SWORD ATTACK SPRITE ATLAS. The reference contains ONLY ONE character in different animation poses: Rustblade Squire. 24 actual sequential different poses, one readable attack not 24 repeated swings. Sword remains rigid and held by same right hand, no melting or changing length. Keep sword visible except genuine body occlusion. No baked slash trails, no motion blur or painted target. Need coherent successive anatomy, not differently sized disconnected sketches.
